name: zemtu
title: Zemtu
description: Find and book vehicles with your Zemtu account
author: Roland

commands.name: time-based-search
commands.title: Find Vehicles in Time Range
commands.subtitle: Zemtu
commands.description: Search for vehicles available in a specific time range

commands.name: menu-bar-reservations
commands.title: Menu Bar Reservations
commands.subtitle: Zemtu
commands.description: Show current and upcoming vehicle reservations in menu bar

commands.name: check-settings
commands.title: Check Settings
commands.subtitle: Zemtu
commands.description: Check that the Zemtu URL, login, location and vehicle access are set up correctly

tools.name: find-available-vehicles
tools.title: Find Available Vehicles
tools.description: Find Zemtu vehicles that are free for a whole time range, sorted by distance to the user. Returns vehicle ids needed for booking.

tools.name: get-my-reservations
tools.title: Get My Reservations
tools.description: List the user's current and upcoming Zemtu reservations with vehicle, start, end and status.

tools.name: create-reservation
tools.title: Create Reservation
tools.description: Book a Zemtu vehicle for a time range. The user always has to confirm the booking before it is made.

ai.instructions: You help the user find and book Zemtu carsharing vehicles. Interpret all times in the user's local timezone and pass ISO 8601 with offset. Before booking, always call find-available-vehicles for the exact time range and only use a vehicle id from its result; never guess ids. If the vehicle, the date or the start or end time is ambiguous, ask the user instead of assuming (e.g. "tomorrow morning" needs concrete times). Book with create-reservation only when the user asked to book; the user confirms every booking. Use purpose BUSINESS only if the user says it is a business trip. Reply in the user's language.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Zemtu URL
preferences.description: The web address of your carsharing provider's Zemtu, e.g. https://yourcompany.zemtu.com. Default: https://demo.zemtu.com (demo system).

preferences.name: username
preferences.title: Username
preferences.description: The username you use to log in to Zemtu

preferences.name: password
preferences.title: Password
preferences.description: Your Zemtu password (stored encrypted by Raycast)

preferences.name: enableMenuBar
preferences.title: Enable Menu Bar
preferences.description: Show reservations in the menu bar (macOS only)
preferences.label: Display current and upcoming reservations in menu bar

preferences.name: location
preferences.title: Your Location
preferences.description: Used to sort vehicles by distance. Enter an address (e.g. Marktplatz 1, Dornbirn) or coordinates (e.g. 47.4486, 9.7621 – right-click a place in Google Maps to copy them). Addresses are looked up once via OpenStreetMap.
